name: gametheory
description: 2x2 game analysis from four payoff cells (TL/TR/BL/BR as row,column pairs): dominant strategies for each player, all pure-strategy Nash equilibria, and the mixed equilibrium verified numerically by player indifference - the formula is never trusted blindly. Degenerate cases are named, not glossed.
route: analyze the game: TL 3,2; TR 1,1; BL 0,3; BR 2,0, game theory: TL -1,-1; TR -3,0; BL 0,-3; BR -2,-2
